verdict.rationale: The EIN online assistant page publishes all three constraints up front: an exact Eastern Time operating window for each day of the week, a limit of 1 EIN per responsible party per day, and a 15-minute inactivity expiry with no save. A founder sees them before starting. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the published window and timeout match live behavior, and comparable published limits for the other online flows (IRIS, the online Form 15620/83(b) flow).
